pr_comments: @ArthurZucker I added a slow test where I set the `logprob_threshold` to 0 to make sure the no-speech detection is triggered. Without the fix, all the outputs are empty because all the no-speech probabilities are >1.

Hey @cifkao, thanks for the PR!
Could you make sure to rebase the branch to fix the failing test ?

> This scenario arises when the model is called with language set and with num_beams > 1.

Also, could you point out why this scenario applies when language is set ? I understand the case for num_beams>1 but don't see the point for the other case!
Many thanks!

The docs for this PR live [here](https://moon-ci-docs.huggingface.co/docs/transformers/pr_29248). All of your documentation changes will be reflected on that endpoint. The docs are available until 30 days after the last update.

> Also, could you point out why this scenario applies when language is set ? I understand the case for num_beams>1 but don't see the point for the other case!

@ylacombe The bug manifests only when _both_ conditions (`num_beams > 1` and `language` set) are true. The latter condition causes decoding to start after the language token, which is why we need to call the model again to get the logits at that position (which are then incorrectly treated as log-probabilities). With `language` unset, the decoding starts from the beginning, so we never enter that branch.
Thank you for taking the time to add a test 🔥

issue_context.title: Incorrect no-speech probability in `WhisperNoSpeechDetection` when `language` is set and `num_beams > 1`
issue_context.body:
### System Info

- `transformers` version: 4.39.0.dev0 (`c8d9840`)

### Who can help?

@patrickvonplaten @sanchit-gandhi

### Reproduction

 In [`WhisperNoSpeechDetection`](https://github.com/huggingface/transformers/blob/c8d98405a8f7b0e5d07391b671dcc61bb9d7bad5/src/transformers/generation/logits_process.py#L1893), in some cases, the model is run again inside the logits processor to get the **logits**, but then, if `self.is_scores_logprobs == True`, those logits are run through `exp()` instead of `softmax()`, resulting in incorrect (unnormalized) probabilities (possibly `> 1`).

This scenario arises when the model is called with `language` set and with `num_beams > 1`.

### Expected behavior

The no-speech probability should be the same regardless of the value of `num_beams`.
